answer: Because the ember history dates every edge, the saffron audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 2 epochs of prior interaction to count. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, because the atlas edge has to exist before the case does. Collateral of 46 dollars is at risk. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
